mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONSULT_MESSAGE (MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.sql: c.MESSAGE_ID, c.ROOM_ID, c.SENDER_ID, m.ROLE AS SENDER_ROLE, c.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CONSULT_MESSAGE c JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = c.SENDER_ID WHERE c.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT r.ROOM_ID, m.LOGIN_ID AS CUSTOMER, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(MAX(c.CREATED_AT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT FROM CONSULT_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = r.MEMBER_ID AND m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN CONSULT_MESSAGE c ON c.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID GROUP BY r.ROOM_ID, m.LOGIN_ID, r.CREATED_AT ORDER BY MAX(c.MESSAGE_ID) DESC NULLS LAST, r.ROOM_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
